description: Social Security cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) for a payable year, from the SSA "Cost-of-Living Increase and Other Determinations" notice in the Federal Register. The 2027 COLA is 3.6 percent (effective December 2026, paid January 2027, published 2026-10-26). Also returns the COLA history back to 1996. Without a year it checks the Federal Register API for a newer notice.

history_years.description: How many years of COLA history to include, newest first. Default 10.

year.description: Year the COLA is first paid (January). Default: the latest, 2027.

name: get_social_security_cola
title: Get Social Security COLA
